items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Well, the guy they've got down in the book is Bobby Cheek, and later they had Jack Butler and Taft Jordan.

ctx.x: Richard Clark. Battles, Clark, and I forgot who else --
Well, the guy they've got down in the book is Bobby Cheek, and later they had Jack Butler and Taft Jordan.
They must have come in after I was there.
